get.description: Artwork of one item slot (G40.1), encoded as JPEG without enlargement. The source is chosen per G40.10: a locked image first, then a library file, an NFO reference, a fetched remote image and embedded artwork. Remote images are never fetched while serving a request; one whose bytes are not stored yet is skipped. Without a usable image the Primary slot falls back to the poster next to the media file. Omitting both dimensions selects a 640×640 fit; omitting one leaves that direction unconstrained, subject to the configured output limit. Omitting quality selects the configured default. Source and live access are checked again after rendering, including cache hits and conditional requests. Responses are private and revalidated unless tag equals the SHA-256 of the original image, in which case they are cacheable for a year and immutable; Vary: Authorization, Cookie still applies. Byte ranges and legacy compatibility parameters are not supported.
